title: OptCraft
description: A smooth Fabric experience that provides amazing performance, while also having good graphics.
body:
![thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4561b67d97c9a1874eed57199b4fa82c815c7716.png)
Minecraft, but better and prettier. This is the offical OptCraft, and yeah, its pretty good.

Minecraft itself looks a little boring. But this modpack changes that without take or creating any gameplay from the base game! And peformance is a big part of games, and this pack _also_ has that! Enjoy beaudiful graphics and simple but sharp textures without stressing your computer at all! (most of the times xd)
![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00ceafe1de804ff908fa954bdf26afa7644c56b0.png)

OptCraft comes packed with mods that make Minecraft feel fresh and alive. Now you can enjoy smooth and minecrafty animations with Fresh Animations (FreshLX) And just some first person pleasure with Hold My Items! (Sapling.) And FA-Player Extension
